changelog:
New Features:
• New file management system
• Dark mode interface
• Updated icon set
• GitHub repository cloning support
• Swipe-to-action on file items
• Quick scroll buttons
• Particle background animation (static if animation is 0)
• SD card access support
• Multiple file selection (folders can only be moved)
• File copy/move operations
• Quick ZIP file preview
• New FAB with BottomSheet menu
• CRC32 hash verification
• sora-editor 0.14.0 with TextMate support
• Mini HTML preview
• Image editor
• Enhanced music player

Improvements:
• Improved scroll thumb design
• Replaced ListView with RecyclerView
• Better JSON and Java code formatting
• Terminal enhancements
• New grid view for files
• Advanced swipe-to-refresh implementation
• Improved file loading performance

Deprecations:
• Removed 'Java Codes' activity
• Removed app icon extraction
• Replaced reflection-based translucency with XML styles
• Integrated 'More Tools' into navigation drawer
• Moved extract-code and binary conversion to Editor
• Changed default folder to /storage/emulated/0/CodeXYZ

Known Issues:
• Performance lag with large file lists (device-dependent)
• Crash when tapping with multiple fingers
• Folder corruption during move operations
• Some features may be unstable and there are some glitches in landscape orientation
